title: How to catch a recruiter's attention with your LinkedIn headline
description:
Part 6 in our series of how to optimize your LinkedIn profile. To stand out on LinkedIn, you need a strong headline that uses keywords related to your industry. What does that mean? And how do you write a good headline? 

Here are are formats you can implement right now and examples of each one.
